# NBA Individual performance


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message=F, warning=F)
library(SportsAnalytics270)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(VGAM)
library(zoo)
library(tidyr)
```


## NBA Individual performance

3 main stages of the game.

* Attacking
* Defending
* Possessing the ball

## NBA Individual performance

### Dataset

```{r, include = F}
players_data <- read.csv("../data/players_stats_by_season_full_details.csv")
```

```{r}
str(players_data)
```


## NBA Individual performance


```{r}

players_data_pr <- players_data %>%
  select(Season, Player, MIN, STL, TOV, ORB, DRB, PF, BLK, PTS) %>%
  arrange(Player, Season)  %>% 
  mutate(PR = STL - TOV)

#DFR = defence rating

players_data_diff <- players_data_pr %>%
  arrange(Player, Season)  %>% 
  group_by(Player) %>%
  mutate(CUM_STL = rollsum(STL, k = 2, fill = NA, align="right"),
         CUM_TOV = rollsum(TOV, k = 2, fill = NA, align="right"),
         CUM_DRB = rollsum(DRB, k = 2, fill = NA, align="right"),
         CUM_PF = rollsum(PF, k = 2, fill = NA, align="right"),
         CUM_DFR = CUM_STL - CUM_PF,
         CUM_DFR1 = CUM_DFR - CUM_TOV,
         CUM_POSS_RATING = CUM_STL - CUM_TOV
         ) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  ungroup()


cor(players_data_diff$CUM_DFR1, players_data_diff$MIN)

ggplot(players_data_diff, aes(x = CUM_DFR1, y = (MIN))) + 
  geom_point()

summary(lm(MIN ~ (CUM_DFR1 + CUM_DFR + CUM_POSS_RATING), data = players_data_diff))
```


```{r}
players_data <- players_data %>%
  filter(League == 'NBA', Stage == 'Regular_Season')

players_data_pr_2 <- players_data %>%
  select(Season, Player, GP, PTS,  MIN, FGM, FGA, X3PM, X3PA, FTM, FTA)

players_data_diff_2 <- players_data_pr_2 %>%
  arrange(Player, Season)  %>% 
  group_by(Player) %>%
  mutate(CUM_FGM = rollsum(FGM, k = 2, fill = NA, align="right"),
         CUM_FGA = rollsum(FGA, k = 2, fill = NA, align="right"),
         CUM_X3PM = rollsum(X3PM, k = 2, fill = NA, align="right"),
         CUM_X3PA = rollsum(X3PA, k = 2, fill = NA, align="right"),
         CUM_FTM = rollsum(FTM, k = 2, fill = NA, align="right"),
         CUM_FTA = rollsum(FTA, k = 2, fill = NA, align="right"),
         CUM_FGDIFF = CUM_FGA - CUM_FGM,
         CUM_X3PMDIFF = CUM_X3PA - CUM_X3PM,
         CUM_FTDIFF = CUM_FTA - CUM_FTM) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  ungroup()


ggplot(players_data_diff_2, aes(x = CUM_FGDIFF, y = MIN)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

cor(players_data_diff_2$CUM_FGDIFF, players_data_diff_2$MIN)

summary(lm(MIN ~ CUM_FGDIFF + CUM_X3PMDIFF + CUM_FTDIFF, 
           data = players_data_diff_2))
```
